_written: 2026-10-10, AFTER T1 was rejected (session-only trend P&L negative; overnight positive in 8/9 markets). BEFORE any T2 return. Generation 24.
hypothesis: T2_TREND_GLOBEX: hold the daily trend direction from the Globex reopen (17:00 CT) to 15:00 CT next day - inside one Topstep trading day (starts 5:00 PM CT, flat by 3:10 PM CT); captures the overnight part where T1's diagnostic located the trend P&L. Weekend gap (Fri 15:00 CT -> Sun 17:00 CT) and 15:00-17:00 CT are not held.
signal: EWMAC mean of speeds (8,32),(16,64),(32,128) on daily closes (close = last hourly bar before 16:00 ET) through the PREVIOUS day; position sign = sign(forecast), size proportional to |forecast| capped at 1, scaled by 1/(20-day std of the 09-15 CT session return)
execution: signal from the close of the 15:00 ET hourly bar (= 16:00 ET) of day D-1; enter at the open of the 18:00 ET bar on the evening of D-1 (Sunday evening for Monday); exit at the close of the 15:00 ET bar of day D (= 15:00 CT); a full round trip every trading day

costs_round_trip_bp_of_notional.derivation: qpl.instruments cost_per_rt (commission + 1 tick slippage per side) / (point value x typical price)

contamination: Dukascopy intraday 2013-2023 was used by earlier intraday hypotheses (v1/v3) -> DEV/VAL/TEST are partially contaminated for this data; TopstepX GC/CL/6E/6B/6J never used by any strategy, ES/NQ/RTY used by H3 only. FRESH evaluation starts after the 128-day signal warm-up.

gates.DEV: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 60% instruments with positive net mean

prop_sim: if VAL passes: Topstep 50K Combine simulation (simulator.historical_starts + block bootstrap) on USD P&L of micro contracts; risk budgets per instrument-day {100,200,300} USD; worst = intraday MAE
